name: Aceternity UI
license: Custom Aceternity License for Pro/downloadable items; free component availability does not establish a blanket MIT license
notes: No authoritative public repository for the full component library found. Official brand facts link https://github.com/aceternity, an account, not a repository; its public API lists nextjs-boilerplate and saasternity, which are different projects and must not be substituted. Official source distribution is copy/paste component documentation and https://ui.aceternity.com/registry/{name}.json; setup docs: https://ui.aceternity.com/installation. Free components coexist with paid blocks/pages/templates. The custom licensing page permits unlimited personal/client end products, including commercial websites, but prohibits source-file redistribution, marketplace redistribution/resale, and themes/templates/derivative products for marketplace sale; team-size licensing applies. The page is headed as Pro licensing, so do not silently label every free component proprietary or MIT: check item-specific notices. General terms reserve IP and contain broader restrictions; use the specific licence and item terms for the intended use. Official pages disagree on component counts/pricing, so no single count or price is asserted here.

evidence.quote: Every component page also shows the full source.
You can create unlimited end products for yourself or your clients.

name: Crucible
license: MIT for free components; paid single-seat personal license for Pro components (not open source)
notes: No authoritative public repository found on the official site or in targeted search. Unrelated projects named Crucible must not be substituted. Documentation and source are on individual component pages; free source also installs from https://crucibleui.com/r/<name>.json. The official license page states 114 free MIT components; the homepage/pricing describe 238 total, including 124 Pro. Free components allow commercial use with MIT notice preservation. Pro is a lifetime purchase with commercial use on unlimited projects, but under a single-seat personal license, not MIT; a free preview does not grant free access to Pro source.

evidence.quote: Crucible has two tiers. The free tier is open source under the MIT License; the pro tier is a paid, single-seat personal license.
All 114 free components, as installed from `crucibleui.com/r/<name>.json`, are released under the MIT License.
Pro components are not open source.
Commercial use on unlimited projects
